take: Cue = anchor (beat, downbeat, named marker, segment start or end) plus a beat or ms offset plus parameter-range, segment and mode filters. gap: gap 3: command palette with fuzzy ranking
take: Two-tier ranking: queries of two chars or fewer use exact word-prefix order, three or more use SkimMatcherV2 fuzzy score, then a saturating frecency boost of at most 60 percent (pivot 2.0) so usage breaks ties but never beats a clearly better text match. Tests assert both paths.

gap: gap 1: contact sheet with a per-tile score
take: Grid sheet: grid_desired_size divides the target width by columns, frames land in parallel, the compositor draws timestamp and caption text per tile with a shadow pass then a colour pass. Each frame carries an FFT blurriness score plus average colour; selection sorts by score and drops near-duplicate colours. ffmpeg is only the frame source.
